units.displayText: Of course. We're about to meet up with Squad Magnhilda.

units.rawText: You have my thanks. You're responsible for the most imperative of assignments; I wish you the best of luck. Tell us if you encounter further difficulties.

units.displayText: These Low Order Entropics should, by all rights, prioritize attacking these agents, but they went out of their way to transfer fire to the balloons instead.

spans.text: These Low Order Entropics should, by all rights, prioritize attacking these agents, but they went out of their way to transfer fire to the balloons instead.

units.rawText: This jellyfish should be the Entropic in command here.
units.displayText: This jellyfish should be the Entropic in command here.

spans.text: This jellyfish should be the Entropic in command here.

units.rawText: But the books told me that jellyfish didn't have brains... ah, the data's done processing!
units.displayText: But the books told me that jellyfish didn't have brains... ah, the data's done processing!

spans.text: But the books told me that jellyfish didn't have brains... ah, the data's done processing!

units.rawText: The jellyfish... is absorbing operands from the environment!
units.displayText: The jellyfish... is absorbing operands from the environment!

spans.text: The jellyfish... is absorbing operands from the environment!

units.rawText: So it was the data from the balloon that made you... in any case, I'll contact Persicaria first.

spans.text: So it was the data from the balloon that made you... in any case, I'll contact Persicaria first.

units.rawText: ...That's why I think we need a certain amount of combat support to eliminate this jellyfish and the Low Order Entropics nearby.
units.displayText: ...That's why I think we need a certain amount of combat support to eliminate this jellyfish and the Low Order Entropics nearby.

spans.text: ...That's why I think we need a certain amount of combat support to eliminate this jellyfish and the Low Order Entropics nearby.

units.rawText: I understand. So, you mean to say that this jellyfish possesses the ability to direct other Entropics and are different from the other Low Order Entropics.
units.displayText: I understand. So, you mean to say that this jellyfish possesses the ability to direct other Entropics and are different from the other Low Order Entropics.

spans.text: I understand. So, you mean to say that this jellyfish possesses the ability to direct other Entropics and are different from the other Low Order Entropics.

units.rawText: And it absorbs operands... judging by the circumstances, we can be more or less sure that it's siphoning the Sandbox Barrier's operands away.
units.displayText: And it absorbs operands... judging by the circumstances, we can be more or less sure that it's siphoning the Sandbox Barrier's operands away.

spans.text: And it absorbs operands... judging by the circumstances, we can be more or less sure that it's siphoning the Sandbox Barrier's operands away.

units.rawText: I must say that attacking hastily also poses risks, such as triggering explosions. We may cause more damage to the Sandbox Barrier than we can prevent.
units.displayText: I must say that attacking hastily also poses risks, such as triggering explosions. We may cause more damage to the Sandbox Barrier than we can prevent.

spans.text: I must say that attacking hastily also poses risks, such as triggering explosions. We may cause more damage to the Sandbox Barrier than we can prevent.

units.rawText: If we allow it to continue consuming the operands from the barrier, our repairs will be equivalent to feeding it.
units.displayText: If we allow it to continue consuming the operands from the barrier, our repairs will be equivalent to feeding it.

spans.text: If we allow it to continue consuming the operands from the barrier, our repairs will be equivalent to feeding it.

units.rawText: That's true... can we possibly lure it away from the Oasis?
units.displayText: That's true... can we possibly lure it away from the Oasis?

spans.text: That's true... can we possibly lure it away from the Oasis?

units.rawText: Hmm... so we are looking for a solution that both avoids combat and gets that Entropic away from the barrier?
units.displayText: Hmm... so we are looking for a solution that both avoids combat and gets that Entropic away from the barrier?

spans.text: Hmm... so we are looking for a solution that both avoids combat and gets that Entropic away from the barrier?

units.rawText: Horizon looks at the Entropic again as it clambers onto the firewall. The colors inside its protoplasm churn, growing more and more intense as it gorges upon operands.
units.displayText: Horizon looks at the Entropic again as it clambers onto the firewall. The colors inside its protoplasm churn, growing more and more intense as it gorges upon operands.

spans.text: Horizon looks at the Entropic again as it clambers onto the firewall. The colors inside its protoplasm churn, growing more and more intense as it gorges upon operands.

units.rawText: ...Wait, Mai, did it eat the entirety of your balloons?
units.displayText: ...Wait, Mai, did it eat the entirety of your balloons?

spans.text: ...Wait, Mai, did it eat the entirety of your balloons?

units.rawText: Yeah, even the observational equipment on it...
units.displayText: Yeah, even the observational equipment on it...

spans.text: Yeah, even the observational equipment on it...

units.rawText: Look, the jellyfish Entropic is even swelling like a balloon... <size=28>It looks a bit cute.</size>
units.displayText: Look, the jellyfish Entropic is even swelling like a balloon... It looks a bit cute.

spans.text: Look, the jellyfish Entropic is even swelling like a balloon...
It looks a bit cute.

units.rawText: Thankfully, it's only eaten one. If we can retrieve the other and fix it up a bit, maybe it'd still be good for something...
units.displayText: Thankfully, it's only eaten one. If we can retrieve the other and fix it up a bit, maybe it'd still be good for something...

spans.text: Thankfully, it's only eaten one. If we can retrieve the other and fix it up a bit, maybe it'd still be good for something...

units.rawText: Was there anything special about the one it ate?
units.displayText: Was there anything special about the one it ate?

spans.text: Was there anything special about the one it ate?

units.rawText: Ah! Well, I wanted to make that one fly higher for a bit longer so it wouldn't get caught in the crossfire, so I loaded it with some extra operands.
units.displayText: Ah! Well, I wanted to make that one fly higher for a bit longer so it wouldn't get caught in the crossfire, so I loaded it with some extra operands.

spans.text: Ah! Well, I wanted to make that one fly higher for a bit longer so it wouldn't get caught in the crossfire, so I loaded it with some extra operands.

units.rawText: But it's not like that did any good... my balloon, my operands...

spans.text: But it's not like that did any good... my balloon, my operands...

units.rawText: So the one you wanted to hold onto the most got eaten instead...
units.displayText: So the one you wanted to hold onto the most got eaten instead...

spans.text: So the one you wanted to hold onto the most got eaten instead...

units.rawText: Wahhh... stop it...
units.displayText: Wahhh... stop it...

spans.text: Wahhh... stop it...

units.rawText: Hang on, could it be attracted to things that hold a high amount of operands?
units.displayText: Hang on, could it be attracted to things that hold a high amount of operands?

spans.text: Hang on, could it be attracted to things that hold a high amount of operands?

units.rawText: Considering its consumption of the operands from the barrier, I would agree with that conclusion.
units.displayText: Considering its consumption of the operands from the barrier, I would agree with that conclusion.

spans.text: Considering its consumption of the operands from the barrier, I would agree with that conclusion.

units.rawText: Luring it away with a package of operands... I think I get it.
units.displayText: Luring it away with a package of operands... I think I get it.

spans.text: Luring it away with a package of operands... I think I get it.

units.rawText: Wait! Are we really not taking this opportunity to eliminate it? Releasing it now is bound to create a nuisance later.
units.displayText: Wait! Are we really not taking this opportunity to eliminate it? Releasing it now is bound to create a nuisance later.

spans.text: Wait! Are we really not taking this opportunity to eliminate it? Releasing it now is bound to create a nuisance later.

units.rawText: Currently, repairing the barrier is our biggest priority.
units.displayText: Currently, repairing the barrier is our biggest priority.

spans.text: Currently, repairing the barrier is our biggest priority.

units.rawText: This siphoning of operands is only happening due to the barrier's defense systems being offline. Once the repairs are complete, we'll naturally be able to fend them off.
units.displayText: This siphoning of operands is only happening due to the barrier's defense systems being offline. Once the repairs are complete, we'll naturally be able to fend them off.

spans.text: This siphoning of operands is only happening due to the barrier's defense systems being offline. Once the repairs are complete, we'll naturally be able to fend them off.

units.rawText: ...Alright. I'll try to draw it away with operands.
units.displayText: ...Alright. I'll try to draw it away with operands.

spans.text: ...Alright. I'll try to draw it away with operands.

units.rawText: What are you thinking?
units.displayText: What are you thinking?

spans.text: What are you thinking?

units.displayText: Horizon's gaze drifts sideways, finding Mai, still standing by the side.

spans.text: Horizon's gaze drifts sideways, finding Mai, still standing by the side.

units.displayText: My last balloon...

spans.text: My last balloon...

units.rawText: Please, Mai.
units.displayText: Please, Mai.

spans.text: Please, Mai.

units.rawText: O-okay!
units.displayText: O-okay!

spans.text: O-okay!

units.displayText: Some minutes later, the Oasis' Ops Room.

units.rawText: Operation successful.
units.displayText: Operation successful.

units.rawText: Good work. Is everyone alright?
units.displayText: Good work. Is everyone alright?

spans.text: Good work. Is everyone alright?

units.rawText: Mai was responsible for precisely adjusting the distance between the balloon and the jellyfish. Too close, and it'd be shot down. Too far, and the jellyfish will lose interest.
units.displayText: Mai was responsible for precisely adjusting the distance between the balloon and the jellyfish. Too close, and it'd be shot down. Too far, and the jellyfish will lose interest.

spans.text: Mai was responsible for precisely adjusting the distance between the balloon and the jellyfish. Too close, and it'd be shot down. Too far, and the jellyfish will lose interest.

units.rawText: She spent a great amount of operands towards that end; she's gone to rest for now. <size=28>Of course, it might also be the trauma from losing all of her balloons...</size>
units.displayText: She spent a great amount of operands towards that end; she's gone to rest for now. Of course, it might also be the trauma from losing all of her balloons...

Of course, it might also be the trauma from losing all of her balloons...

units.rawText: Magnhilda drew the attention of the Low Order Entropics and has sustained some minor injuries, nothing serious.
units.displayText: Magnhilda drew the attention of the Low Order Entropics and has sustained some minor injuries, nothing serious.

spans.text: Magnhilda drew the attention of the Low Order Entropics and has sustained some minor injuries, nothing serious.

units.rawText: There's also the good news that the Low Order Entropics followed the jellyfish Entropic as it left.
units.displayText: There's also the good news that the Low Order Entropics followed the jellyfish Entropic as it left.

spans.text: There's also the good news that the Low Order Entropics followed the jellyfish Entropic as it left.

units.rawText: If the Low Order Entropics follow it as it moves, I think we can be sure that it has control over them...

spans.text: If the Low Order Entropics follow it as it moves, I think we can be sure that it has control over them...

units.rawText: But let's leave that for another time. Good work, all of you.
units.displayText: But let's leave that for another time. Good work, all of you.

spans.text: But let's leave that for another time. Good work, all of you.

units.rawText: Much of it was thanks to Mai... and her balloons.
units.displayText: Much of it was thanks to Mai... and her balloons.

spans.text: Much of it was thanks to Mai... and her balloons.

units.rawText: Haha, there'll always be more balloons so long as we weather this storm. We'll be counting on you for the barrier repairs.
units.displayText: Haha, there'll always be more balloons so long as we weather this storm. We'll be counting on you for the barrier repairs.

spans.text: Haha, there'll always be more balloons so long as we weather this storm. We'll be counting on you for the barrier repairs.

units.rawText: Understood.
units.displayText: Understood.

spans.text: Understood.

units.displayText: Persicaria ends the call, heaving a lengthy sigh as she sinks into her chair.

spans.text: Persicaria ends the call, heaving a lengthy sigh as she sinks into her chair.

units.rawText: The barrier's repairs have begun and the Entropics within the Oasis have largely been cleaned up... Looks like the situation is stabilizing, at least for now.
units.displayText: The barrier's repairs have begun and the Entropics within the Oasis have largely been cleaned up... Looks like the situation is stabilizing, at least for now.

spans.text: The barrier's repairs have begun and the Entropics within the Oasis have largely been cleaned up... Looks like the situation is stabilizing, at least for now.

units.rawText: You were listening, Daiyan?
units.displayText: You were listening, Daiyan?

spans.text: You were listening, Daiyan?

units.rawText: I just happened to have a report for you. The areas within the Oasis still submitting alerts have reduced greatly as well. Good work, Persicaria, I think you ought to have a rest.
units.displayText: I just happened to have a report for you. The areas within the Oasis still submitting alerts have reduced greatly as well. Good work, Persicaria, I think you ought to have a rest.

units.rawText: We cannot let our guard down just yet. Next...
units.displayText: We cannot let our guard down just yet. Next...

spans.text: We cannot let our guard down just yet. Next...

units.displayText: Persicaria turns down the magnification on her map, inspecting a patch outside the Oasis.

spans.text: Persicaria turns down the magnification on her map, inspecting a patch outside the Oasis.

units.rawText: We need to repair our communication relays.
units.displayText: We need to repair our communication relays.

spans.text: We need to repair our communication relays.

units.rawText: Must we really dedicate logistics and manpower now? Would the pressure be too great on our existing frontlines?
units.displayText: Must we really dedicate logistics and manpower now? Would the pressure be too great on our existing frontlines?

spans.text: Must we really dedicate logistics and manpower now? Would the pressure be too great on our existing frontlines?

units.rawText: The Rossum Railgun's blast destroyed the majority of our communications infrastructure. Additionally, for unknown reasons, our backup communications equipment has been rendered unusable.
units.displayText: The Rossum Railgun's blast destroyed the majority of our communications infrastructure. Additionally, for unknown reasons, our backup communications equipment has been rendered unusable.

spans.text: The Rossum Railgun's blast destroyed the majority of our communications infrastructure. Additionally, for unknown reasons, our backup communications equipment has been rendered unusable.

units.rawText: Our enemy perhaps intentionally sought to cut off contact with the outside. As it is, we cannot communicate with our expeditionary teams or request assistance.
units.displayText: Our enemy perhaps intentionally sought to cut off contact with the outside. As it is, we cannot communicate with our expeditionary teams or request assistance.

spans.text: Our enemy perhaps intentionally sought to cut off contact with the outside. As it is, we cannot communicate with our expeditionary teams or request assistance.

units.rawText: To better repel what enemies may come in future, we must restore communications.
units.displayText: To better repel what enemies may come in future, we must restore communications.

spans.text: To better repel what enemies may come in future, we must restore communications.

units.rawText: ...But no matter what, when we are so thinly stretched in personnel, this is far too rash of a decision.
units.displayText: ...But no matter what, when we are so thinly stretched in personnel, this is far too rash of a decision.

spans.text: ...But no matter what, when we are so thinly stretched in personnel, this is far too rash of a decision.

units.rawText: We have no intel whatsoever on what is going on outside the Oasis. If the difficulty of restoring communications proves to be too great, or we fall under attack by another swarm of Entropics—

units.rawText: Daiyan, you understand what I'm getting at, yes?
units.displayText: Daiyan, you understand what I'm getting at, yes?

spans.text: Daiyan, you understand what I'm getting at, yes?

units.rawText: ...Yeah.
units.displayText: ...Yeah.

spans.text: ...Yeah.

units.rawText: ...It'll have to be done if we want to hear from the Professor.
units.displayText: ...It'll have to be done if we want to hear from the Professor.

spans.text: ...It'll have to be done if we want to hear from the Professor.

units.rawText: Yes. The Oasis needs its linchpin that everyone is expecting... If the Professor comes back, all will be well.
units.displayText: Yes. The Oasis needs its linchpin that everyone is expecting... If the Professor comes back, all will be well.

spans.text: Yes. The Oasis needs its linchpin that everyone is expecting... If the Professor comes back, all will be well.

units.rawText: You get it, right?
units.displayText: You get it, right?

units.displayText: Reticent, Daiyan nods.

spans.text: Reticent, Daiyan nods.

units.rawText: If you will, Daiyan, please help me with the personnel distribution.
